ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
<image>In $\odot R, S U=20, Y W=20,$ and $m \widehat{Y X}=45$.
Find $m\widehat{S T}$
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Geometry3K open-ended problem

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is a circle with R as the center, S is above the circle, T is on the upper right, U is on the right side, W is on the lower right, X is below and to the left, and Y is on the left side. The blue segments SU and YW are chords inside the circle. Segment RT starts from the center R and intersects chord SU at V, with a right-angle mark beside it, indicating RT ⟂ SU. Another line passing through S, R, and X intersects chord YW at Z, also with a right-angle mark beside it, indicating that this center line is perpendicular to chord YW. Then reason: The perpendicular from the center of a circle to a chord bisects that chord, and also bisects the arc subtended by that chord. Therefore, X is the midpoint of minor arc YW, so m arc YX = m arc XW. It is known that m arc YX = 45, so m arc XW = 45, and minor arc YW = 45 + 45 = 90. Also because SU = 20 and YW = 20, in the same circle, minor arcs subtended by equal chords are equal, so minor arc SU = minor arc YW = 90. Since T is the midpoint of minor arc SU, m arc ST = 90 ÷ 2 = 45.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify that R is the center of the circle, the blue segments SU and YW are chords, and the radii/center-lines from R meet those chords at right angles: RT meets chord SU at V and RX/RS line meets chord YW at Z. Since a perpendicular from the center to a chord bisects the chord and its intercepted minor arc, X is the midpoint of minor arc YW and T is the midpoint of minor arc SU. From the text, use m arc YX = 45, so arc XW is also 45 and minor arc YW = 90. Since the text gives SU = 20 and YW = 20, congruent chords in the same circle subtend congruent minor arcs, so minor arc SU = minor arc YW = 90. Because T bisects arc SU, m arc ST = 90/2 = 45.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是以 R 为圆心的圆，S 在圆的上方，T 在右上方，U 在右侧，W 在右下方，X 在下方偏左，Y 在左侧。蓝色线段 SU 和 YW 是圆内的弦。线段 RT 从圆心 R 出发，在 V 处与弦 SU 相交，旁边有直角标记，表示 RT ⟂ SU。另一条经过 S、R、X 的线在 Z 处与弦 YW 相交，旁边也有直角标记，表示该中心线垂直于弦 YW。

再推理：圆心到弦的垂线会平分该弦，并且平分该弦所对的弧。因此，X 是小弧 YW 的中点，所以 m弧YX = m弧XW。已知 m弧YX = 45，所以 m弧XW = 45，小弧 YW = 45 + 45 = 90。又因为 SU = 20 且 YW = 20，在同一个圆中等长的弦所对的小弧相等，所以小弧 SU = 小弧 YW = 90。由于 T 是小弧 SU 的中点，所以 m弧ST = 90 ÷ 2 = 45。

method.method_draft: Use a central-angle/chord-measure approach. From the image, note that RX is perpendicular to chord YW, so RX is the perpendicular bisector of chord YW and also bisects the central angle/arc determined by YW. Thus the central angle for chord YW is twice the arc YX measure: m arc YW = 2(45) = 90. From the text, chord SU has the same length as chord YW, namely 20, so in the same circle the central angles subtending SU and YW are equal; hence m arc SU = 90. The image also shows RT perpendicular to chord SU, so RT bisects the central angle/arc SU, placing T halfway along minor arc SU. Therefore m arc ST = 90/2 = 45.

推理：因为 RX 垂直于弦 YW，且 R 是圆心，所以经过圆心且垂直于弦的直线会平分该弦所对的弧。因此 X 是弧 YW 的中点，已知 m弧YX = 45，所以 m弧YW = 2 × 45 = 90。又因为 SU = 20 且 YW = 20，所以弦 SU 与弦 YW 等长；同一圆中等长弦所对的弧相等，因此 m弧SU = 90。图中 RT 垂直于弦 SU，所以 RT 平分弧 SU，点 T 是弧 SU 的中点。因此 m弧ST = 90 ÷ 2 = 45。
